comment: Hand-written Pose Landmarker world points (metres about the hips' centre, x to the subject's left in an unmirrored frame, y down, z away from the camera) as [x, y, z, visibility], and Hand Landmarker world points of the subject's left hand as [x, y, z]. 'tpose' stands as the test skeleton's rest pose; 'bent' drops both arms, bends the left elbow forward and hides the right knee; 'hand' is the left hand flat in the T-pose; 'curl' bends its index finger down at the knuckle. The test fills unlisted points with visibility 0. No model produced them.
